-- ============================================================================
-- String literal union types
-- ============================================================================

--- How a GPU buffer will be used. Pass to `GPUBuffer.new`.
---
--- * `vertex`
--- * `index`
--- * `uniform`
export type BufferUsage = 'vertex' | 'index' | 'uniform'

--- A buffer usage, or an array of usages. The array form is reserved for
--- future multi-usage flags; today exactly one usage is supported.
export type BufferUsageArg = BufferUsage | { BufferUsage }

--- Texture dimensionality (WebGPU canonical strings).
---
--- * `2d`
--- * `cube`
--- * `3d`
--- * `2d-array`
export type TextureType = '2d' | 'cube' | '3d' | '2d-array'

--- Which planes of a depth/stencil texture a view exposes.
--- Use 'depth-only' for depth textures sampled as texture_depth_2d in WGSL.
---
--- - `all`
--- - `depth-only`
--- - `stencil-only`
export type TextureAspect = 'all' | 'depth-only' | 'stencil-only'

--- Depth comparison function for pipeline depth-stencil state and shadow samplers.
---
--- * `never`
--- * `less`
--- * `equal`
--- * `less-equal`
--- * `greater`
--- * `not-equal`
--- * `greater-equal`
--- * `always`
export type CompareFunction = 'never' | 'less' | 'equal' | 'less-equal'
    | 'greater' | 'not-equal' | 'greater-equal' | 'always'

--- GPU primitive assembly topology.
---
--- * `triangle-list`
--- * `triangle-strip`
--- * `line-list`
--- * `line-strip`
--- * `point-list`
export type PrimitiveTopology = 'triangle-list' | 'triangle-strip' | 'line-list' | 'line-strip' | 'point-list'

--- What to do with an attachment at the start of a render pass.
--- * `clear` — Fill with `clearColor` or `depthClearValue`.
--- * `load` — Preserve the existing contents.
export type LoadOp = 'clear' | 'load'

--- What to do with an attachment at the end of a render pass.
--- * `store` — Keep the rendered result.
--- * `discard` — Discard the contents after the pass.
export type StoreOp = 'store' | 'discard'

--- Per-vertex attribute format (WebGPU canonical strings).
---
--- * `float32`
--- * `float32x2`
--- * `float32x3`
--- * `float32x4`
--- * `uint8x4`
--- * `unorm8x4`
--- * `snorm8x4`
--- * `float16x2`
--- * `float16x4`
export type VertexFormat = 'float32' | 'float32x2' | 'float32x3' | 'float32x4'
    | 'uint8x4' | 'unorm8x4' | 'snorm8x4' | 'float16x2' | 'float16x4'

--- Triangle face culling mode.
---
--- * `none`
--- * `front`
--- * `back`
export type CullMode = 'none' | 'front' | 'back'

--- Texture filtering mode.
---
--- * `nearest`
--- * `linear`
export type Filter = 'nearest' | 'linear'

--- Texture address / wrap mode.
---
--- * `repeat`
--- * `mirror-repeat`
--- * `clamp-to-edge`
export type WrapMode = 'repeat' | 'mirror-repeat' | 'clamp-to-edge'

--- Blend factor for src/dst color and alpha (WebGPU canonical strings).
---
--- * `zero`
--- * `one`
--- * `src`
--- * `one-minus-src`
--- * `src-alpha`
--- * `one-minus-src-alpha`
--- * `dst`
--- * `one-minus-dst`
--- * `dst-alpha`
--- * `one-minus-dst-alpha`
--- * `src-alpha-saturated`
--- * `constant`
--- * `one-minus-constant`
export type BlendFactor = 'zero' | 'one' | 'src' | 'one-minus-src'
    | 'src-alpha' | 'one-minus-src-alpha' | 'dst' | 'one-minus-dst'
    | 'dst-alpha' | 'one-minus-dst-alpha'
    | 'src-alpha-saturated' | 'constant' | 'one-minus-constant'

--- Blend equation operator.
---
--- * `add`
--- * `subtract`
--- * `reverse-subtract`
--- * `min`
--- * `max`
export type BlendOp = 'add' | 'subtract' | 'reverse-subtract' | 'min' | 'max'

--- RGBA clear color in 0–1 range (e.g. {0, 0, 0, 1} for opaque black).
--- Supports HDR values beyond 1.0 for float render targets.
--- Use `Color.toFloat()` to convert from a packed ARGB Color.
export type GPUColor = { number }

-- GPUFeatures

--- Optional GPU capabilities. Returned by `context:features()`.
export type GPUFeatures = {
    --- BC (S3TC/DXT) compressed texture formats supported.
    bc: boolean,
    --- ETC2 compressed texture formats supported (common on mobile).
    etc2: boolean,
    --- ASTC compressed texture formats supported.
    astc: boolean,
    --- Maximum 2-D texture width or height in texels.
    maxTextureSize2D: number,
    --- Maximum cube-map face size in texels.
    maxTextureSizeCube: number,
    --- Maximum 3-D texture depth / layer count.
    maxTextureSize3D: number,
    --- Anisotropic texture filtering supported.
    anisotropicFiltering: boolean,
    --- 3-D textures supported.
    texture3D: boolean,
    --- Texture arrays supported.
    textureArrays: boolean,
    --- 32-bit float color render targets supported (rgba32float etc).
    colorBufferFloat: boolean,
    --- 16-bit float color render targets supported (rgba16float etc). Implied
    --- by colorBufferFloat, but can be present without it on WebGL.
    colorBufferHalfFloat: boolean,
    --- Independent blend state per color attachment supported.
    perTargetBlend: boolean,
    --- Independent write mask per color attachment supported.
    perTargetWriteMask: boolean,
    --- Non-zero firstInstance in draw calls supported.
    drawBaseInstance: boolean,
    --- Depth bias clamping (depthBiasClamp) supported in pipeline state.
    depthBiasClamp: boolean,
    --- Maximum number of simultaneous color attachments.
    maxColorAttachments: number,
    --- Maximum uniform buffer binding size in bytes.
    maxUniformBufferSize: number,
    --- Maximum number of samplers per shader stage.
    maxSamplers: number,
    --- Maximum MSAA sample count for color render targets (always a power-of-two: 1, 2, 4, or 8).
    maxSamples: number,
}

-- ============================================================================
-- GPUBuffer
-- ============================================================================

--- A GPU buffer for vertex, index, or uniform data.
declare extern type GPUBuffer with
    --- Size in bytes.
    size: number
    --- Copy CPU data into the buffer.
    --- @param data       Source bytes.
    --- @param offset     Byte offset into the GPU buffer (default 0).
    --- @param srcOffset  Byte offset into `data` to copy from (default 0).
    --- @param byteLength Bytes to copy (default: the rest of `data` from
    ---                   `srcOffset`). Lets a script upload a prefix of an
    ---                   oversized staging buffer without slicing it.
    function write(self, data: buffer, offset: number?, srcOffset: number?, byteLength: number?): ()
end

--- Descriptor for `GPUBuffer.new`.
export type GPUBufferDesc = {
    --- Size in bytes. Not checked against the shader's struct — lay a uniform
    --- buffer out by hand to the WGSL alignment rules (vec2 to 8, vec3/vec4
    --- and array elements to 16); a wrong offset reads garbage silently.
    size: number,
    --- How the buffer will be used.
    usage: BufferUsageArg,
    --- Optional initial contents. Required when `immutable` is true; its
    --- length must equal `size`.
    data: buffer?,
    --- When true the buffer is GPU-only and cannot be written after creation.
    immutable: boolean?,
    --- Optional debug name.
    label: string?,
}

declare GPUBuffer: {
    new: @checked (desc: GPUBufferDesc) -> GPUBuffer,
}

-- ============================================================================
-- GPUTexture / GPUTextureView
-- ============================================================================

--- A GPU texture (2-D, cube, 3-D, or array).
declare extern type GPUTexture with
    --- Width of mip 0 in texels.
    width: number
    --- Height of mip 0 in texels.
    height: number
    --- Pixel format.
    format: TextureFormat
    --- Create a view into a sub-range of this texture. All fields optional;
    --- omit desc entirely for a full-texture view.
    --- Views are immutable. Create them once at init next to the texture and
    --- reuse them every frame. Calling view() in a per-frame draw callback
    --- creates and destroys a native GPU object each frame.
    function view(self, desc: {
        --- Reinterpret as a different dimensionality.
        dimension: TextureType?,
        --- Planes to expose for depth/stencil textures (default 'all').
        --- Use 'depth-only' for texture_depth_2d in WGSL.
        aspect: TextureAspect?,
        --- First mip level (default 0).
        baseMipLevel: number?,
        --- Number of mip levels (default: all remaining).
        mipCount: number?,
        --- First array layer / cube face (default 0).
        baseLayer: number?,
        --- Number of layers / faces (default: all remaining).
        layerCount: number?,
    }?): GPUTextureView
    --- Upload pixel data to a specific mip / layer.
    function upload(self, desc: {
        --- Raw pixel bytes in the texture's format.
        data: buffer,
        --- Mip level (default 0).
        mipLevel: number?,
        --- Array layer / cube face (default 0).
        layer: number?,
        --- Upload region width (default: the rest of the mip from x).
        width: number?,
        --- Upload region height (default: the rest of the mip from y).
        height: number?,
    }): ()
end

declare GPUTexture: {
    new: @checked (desc: {
        width: number,
        height: number,
        --- Pixel format (default 'rgba8unorm').
        format: TextureFormat?,
        --- Dimensionality (default '2d').
        type: TextureType?,
        --- Allow use as a render target color attachment (default false).
        renderTarget: boolean?,
        --- Number of mip levels (default 1).
        mipmaps: number?,
        --- Array layers or cube faces (default 1).
        layers: number?,
        --- MSAA sample count (default 1). Must be >1 only with renderTarget=true.
        --- MSAA textures cannot have mipmaps or be uploaded/sampled directly —
        --- they must be resolved to a 1x texture first.
        sampleCount: number?,
        --- Debug label for GPU frame-capture tools.
        label: string?,
    }) -> GPUTexture,
}

--- GPUTextureView is declared in the shared "rive/gpu_types" builtin
--- (loaded before rive/image) so that a single nominal type is used
--- everywhere — both Image:view() and GPU render-pass APIs.

        --- Magnification filter (default 'linear').

-- ============================================================================
-- GPUBindGroup
-- ============================================================================

--- An entry binding a uniform buffer into a BindGroup.
--- Dynamic-offset UBOs are declared on each layout entry via
--- `BindGroupLayoutEntry.hasDynamicOffset`, matching WebGPU/Vulkan's
--- layout-level ownership model.
--- `size` defaults to the rest of the buffer past `offset`. The bound range
--- must cover the shader's uniform block or GPUBindGroup.new errors.
export type UBOEntry = {
    slot: number,
    buffer: GPUBuffer,
    offset: number?,
    size: number?,
}

--- An entry binding a texture view into a BindGroup.
export type TextureEntry  = { slot: number, view: GPUTextureView }

--- An entry binding a sampler into a BindGroup.
export type SamplerEntry  = { slot: number, sampler: GPUSampler }

--- Descriptor for creating a GPUBindGroupLayout. Always derived from a
--- shader — the binding map walks shader → kind / visibility / texture
--- metadata / native slots so callers don't have to know any of them.
export type BindGroupLayoutDesc = {
    --- Source shader. Layouts cannot be built without one.
    shader: Shader,
    --- Fragment Shader, when the pipeline this layout serves takes its two
    --- stages from different files. Its bindings and slots live only in its
    --- own map, so a layout built without it cannot resolve them.
    fragment: Shader?,
    --- WGSL `@group(N)` this layout describes. Valid range [0, 4).
    groupIndex: number,
    --- WGSL @binding values whose UBO entries should set hasDynamicOffset.
    dynamicUBOs: { number }?,
    label: string?,
}

--- Public BindGroupLayout — describes the contract a BindGroup conforms
--- to and a Pipeline references for one of its `@group(N)` slots.
---
--- You typically don't construct one directly. Two paths:
---   1. Auto (default) — omit `bindGroupLayouts` on `GPUPipeline.new` and
---      retrieve via `pipeline:getBindGroupLayout(N)` for `GPUBindGroup.new`.
---      Mirrors WebGPU's `layout: 'auto'`.
---   2. Explicit — call `GPUBindGroupLayout.new` and pass the layout to N
---      pipelines via `bindGroupLayouts = { sharedLayout }`. ONE BindGroup
---      then binds across all those pipelines (e.g. a per-frame
---      camera/lights group reused by many materials), avoiding per-
---      pipeline BindGroup duplication and reducing descriptor traffic.
declare extern type GPUBindGroupLayout with
end

declare GPUBindGroupLayout: {
    new: @checked (desc: BindGroupLayoutDesc) -> GPUBindGroupLayout,
}

--- Descriptor for creating a GPUBindGroup. The layout's groupIndex
--- determines which `@group(N)` slot this BindGroup binds to.
export type BindGroupDesc = {
    layout: GPUBindGroupLayout,
    ubos: {UBOEntry}?,
    textures: {TextureEntry}?,
    samplers: {SamplerEntry}?,
}

--- Pre-baked resource bindings reusable across many draw calls.
--- Avoids creating new bind groups every draw — critical for 3D scene
--- performance. Holds strong references to all bound resources (Buffer,
--- TextureView, Sampler), keeping them alive for the BindGroup's lifetime.
declare extern type GPUBindGroup with
end

declare GPUBindGroup: {
    new: @checked (desc: BindGroupDesc) -> GPUBindGroup,
}

-- ============================================================================
-- Pipeline descriptor types
-- ============================================================================

--- Per-vertex attribute within a vertex buffer layout.
--- `offset` is the byte offset of this attribute within the vertex (default 0).
--- For interleaved layouts with multiple attributes you must set offset explicitly,
--- e.g. offset = 0 for position (float3 = 12 bytes), offset = 12 for normal, etc.
export type VertexAttribute = { format: VertexFormat, slot: number, offset: number? }

--- Describes how one vertex buffer feeds attributes to the vertex shader.
export type VertexBufferLayout = {
    --- Byte stride between vertices.
    stride: number,
    --- Advance per vertex or per instance (default 'vertex').
    stepMode: ('vertex' | 'instance')?,
    --- Vertex attributes sourced from this buffer.
    attributes: { VertexAttribute },
}

--- Blend equation for a single color target.
export type BlendState = {
    srcColor: BlendFactor?, dstColor: BlendFactor?, colorOp: BlendOp?,
    srcAlpha: BlendFactor?, dstAlpha: BlendFactor?, alphaOp: BlendOp?,
}

--- Color target format and optional blend state.
export type ColorTarget = {
    format: ColorFormat?,
    blend: BlendState?,
}

--- Depth/stencil fixed-function state. Omit from pipeline to disable depth testing.
export type DepthStencilState = {
    format: DepthFormat?,
    compare: CompareFunction?,
    --- Write depth on pass (default false).
    write: boolean?,
    depthBias: number?,
    depthBiasSlopeScale: number?,
}

-- ============================================================================
-- Render pass descriptor types
-- ============================================================================

--- Color attachment descriptor for canvas:beginRenderPass.
export type ColorAttachment = {
    --- Optional render target view. Defaults to the receiving canvas's
    --- own colorView() when omitted. Provide an explicit view for cases
    --- where the target differs — most commonly MSAA, where `view` is the
    --- multisampled GPUTexture:view() and `resolveTarget` is the canvas's
    --- 1× colorView().
    view: GPUTextureView?,
    --- 1× resolve target for MSAA (formats must match `view`).
    resolveTarget: GPUTextureView?,
    loadOp: LoadOp?,
    --- Required; 'discard' after MSAA resolve, 'store' otherwise.
    storeOp: StoreOp,
    clearColor: GPUColor?,
}

--- Depth/stencil attachment descriptor for canvas:beginRenderPass.
export type DepthStencilAttachment = {
    --- Required. Use GPUTexture:view().
    view: GPUTextureView,
    depthLoadOp: LoadOp?,
    --- Required; 'discard' for transient depth, 'store' to read it later.
    depthStoreOp: StoreOp,
    depthClearValue: number?,
}

--- Render pass descriptor for canvas:beginRenderPass. Must include at
--- least one color attachment or a depthStencil attachment. All attachments
--- (color views + depth) must share one sampleCount, derived per WebGPU
--- rules — pass sampleCount is inferred from the views, not declared.
export type RenderPassDesc = {
    color: { ColorAttachment }?,
    depthStencil: DepthStencilAttachment?,
}

-- ============================================================================
-- GPUPipeline
-- ============================================================================

--- A compiled GPU render pipeline (shaders + fixed-function state).
declare extern type GPUPipeline with
    --- Returns the layout the pipeline auto-derived for `@group(N)`.
    --- Errors if `bindGroupLayouts` was supplied at construction (reuse
    --- the explicit one) or if N is not bound by the shader. Mirrors
    --- WebGPU's `pipeline.getBindGroupLayout(index)`.
    function getBindGroupLayout(self, groupIndex: number): GPUBindGroupLayout
end

--- A pipeline stage: a Shader, or WebGPU-style `{ module = Shader,
--- entryPoint = name }`. The Shader's `@vertex`/`@fragment` functions are the
--- selectable entry points; omit `entryPoint` to use the first one of that
--- stage (like WebGPU).
---
--- Vertex and fragment may come from different Shaders. Each file's bindings
--- are numbered on its own, so on Vulkan, D3D12 and GL — which share one slot
--- namespace between the stages — two files that declare different bindings
--- can collide; `GPUPipeline.new` rejects that case naming both bindings.
--- Declaring the same bindings in both files always works.
export type PipelineStage = Shader | { module: Shader, entryPoint: string? }

declare GPUPipeline: {
    new: @checked (desc: {
        --- Vertex stage (required). A Shader, or `{ module, entryPoint? }`.
        vertex: PipelineStage,
        --- Fragment stage (optional for depth-only passes). A Shader, or
        --- `{ module, entryPoint? }`. When omitted but colorTargets are set,
        --- falls back to the vertex shader's first @fragment.
        fragment: PipelineStage?,
        --- Vertex buffer layouts. Each entry maps to one buffer slot; pass
        --- an empty table for a shader that builds its own positions from
        --- `@builtin(vertex_index)`.
        vertexLayout: { VertexBufferLayout },
        --- Optional. Omit to derive a layout per `@group(N)` from the
        --- shader (WebGPU's `layout: 'auto'`); retrieve via
        --- `pipeline:getBindGroupLayout(N)` for BindGroup creation.
        --- Supply explicitly only to share one layout across multiple
        --- pipelines — e.g. a per-frame camera/lights group reused by
        --- many materials, so a single BindGroup binds to all of them.
        bindGroupLayouts: { GPUBindGroupLayout }?,
        --- Color attachment formats and blend state. Must match the render pass.
        colorTargets: { ColorTarget }?,
        --- Depth/stencil state. Omit to disable depth testing entirely.
        depthStencil: DepthStencilState?,
        --- Face culling (default 'none').
        cullMode: CullMode?,
        --- Primitive topology (default 'triangle-list').
        topology: PrimitiveTopology?,
        --- Must match the sampleCount of the render target. Default: 1.
        sampleCount: number?,
    }) -> GPUPipeline,
}

-- ============================================================================
-- Canvas — Rive 2-D renderer canvas
-- ============================================================================

--- A Rive 2-D renderer canvas. Use `.image` with `renderer:drawImage()`.
--- Call `beginFrame()` to get a Renderer, issue draw calls, then `endFrame()`.
declare extern type Canvas with
    --- Backing image for `renderer:drawImage()`.
    image: Image
    --- Width in pixels.
    width: number
    --- Height in pixels.
    height: number
    --- Resize the canvas. Must not be called between beginFrame() and endFrame().
    function resize(self, width: number, height: number): ()
    --- Begin a Rive frame. Returns a Renderer valid until endFrame().
    --- clearColor is an ARGB integer (e.g. 0xFF000000 = opaque black; default transparent).
    function beginFrame(self, desc: { clearColor: Color? }?): Renderer
    --- Flush draw calls to the backing texture and release the Renderer.
    function endFrame(self): ()
end

-- ============================================================================
-- GPUCanvas — GPU canvas
-- ============================================================================

--- A GPU canvas — a 1× presentation target, same role as a WebGPU surface
--- texture. Use `.image` with `renderer:drawImage()` to composite the
--- result. Render to it via `canvas:beginRenderPass({ color = {{ loadOp =
--- 'clear', storeOp = 'store', ... }} })` — the color attachment's `view`
--- defaults to this canvas's own colorView when omitted. MSAA requires a
--- user-allocated `GPUTexture.new({ sampleCount = N, renderTarget = true
--- })` as the explicit color view, with the canvas's `colorView()` as
--- `resolveTarget`.
declare extern type GPUCanvas with
    --- Backing image for `renderer:drawImage()`.
    image: Image
    --- Width in pixels.
    width: number
    --- Height in pixels.
    height: number
    --- Pixel format of the canvas backing texture, always 'rgba8unorm'. A
    --- deferred canvas reports this before its texture is allocated.
    --- MSAA resolve requires source and target to have identical formats — always
    --- derive GPUTexture and pipeline formats from this value:
    --- ```lua
    ---   local fmt = canvas.format
    ---   GPUPipeline.new({ colorTargets = {{ format = fmt }}, sampleCount = 4 })
    --- ```
    format: ColorFormat
    --- Resize the canvas. Recreates the 1× backing texture. Any
    --- user-allocated MSAA / depth textures must be recreated by the
    --- script to match the new dimensions.
    function resize(self, width: number, height: number): ()
    --- View of the canvas backing texture. Use as a color attachment, an
    --- MSAA resolve target, or a sampler input in a subsequent pass.
    function colorView(self): GPUTextureView
    --- Open a GPU render pass targeting this canvas. The descriptor must
    --- include at least one color attachment or a depthStencil attachment.
    --- Color attachment views default to this canvas's colorView when
    --- omitted; provide them explicitly when rendering to a different
    --- target (e.g. MSAA). The pass's sampleCount is derived from the
    --- attachments (WebGPU rule: all attachments share one sampleCount).
    --- Must be called during draw. Issue draw calls on the
    --- returned pass, then call `:finish()`. A pass may begin while another
    --- is open, as when a drawn artboard's own scripts render: it runs ahead
    --- of the pass it was begun inside, so that pass can sample its output.
    function beginRenderPass(self, desc: RenderPassDesc): GPURenderPass
end

-- ============================================================================
-- GPURenderPass
-- ============================================================================

--- An active render pass. Issue all draw calls before calling finish().
declare extern type GPURenderPass with
    --- Bind a pipeline for subsequent draw calls.
    function setPipeline(self, pipeline: GPUPipeline): ()
    --- Bind a vertex buffer to slot (0-based).
    function setVertexBuffer(self, slot: number, buffer: GPUBuffer): ()
    --- Bind an index buffer. format defaults to 'uint16'.
    function setIndexBuffer(self, buffer: GPUBuffer, format: ('uint16' | 'uint32')?): ()
    --- Bind a pre-created BindGroup to a group slot.
    --- dynamicOffsets: one byte offset per dynamic UBO in this group
    --- (dynamic UBOs are declared on the pipeline via
    --- `BindGroupLayoutEntry.hasDynamicOffset`). Order matches the UBOs' appearance
    --- in `BindGroupDesc.ubos`. Typical 3D pattern: shared texture
    --- BindGroup at group 1, per-object UBO dynamic offset at group 0.
    function setBindGroup(self, groupIndex: number, bg: GPUBindGroup, dynamicOffsets: {number}?): ()
    --- Set the render viewport in pixels. Origin is top-left on all backends except GL (bottom-left).
    function setViewport(self, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): ()
    --- Set the scissor rectangle in pixels.
    function setScissorRect(self, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): ()
    --- Set the stencil reference value.
    function setStencilReference(self, ref: number): ()
    --- Set the constant blend color for 'constant' / 'one-minus-constant' factors.
    function setBlendColor(self, r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number): ()
    --- Non-indexed draw. instanceCount defaults to 1, firstVertex to 0.
    function draw(self, vertexCount: number, instanceCount: number?, firstVertex: number?): ()
    --- Indexed draw. instanceCount defaults to 1, firstIndex to 0.
    function drawIndexed(self, indexCount: number, instanceCount: number?, firstIndex: number?): ()
    --- Submit the pass, along with any pass begun inside it that is still
    --- open. Any further method calls on this object will error.
    function finish(self): ()
end
```
